Every available official ZIP and every actual downloaded file is independently hashed. Peer producer log entries are verified; owner source receipts have no payload manifest, so no producer payload inventory is invented for those bundles.

The separate successful 58e3948 media target-tools build is a different workflow with narrower dependencies; it does not change these owner failures.
